name: sub_0816E570
note: The random-table pointer had to be note-free (no REG_EQUAL, so no REG_EQUIV and no doubled life) to keep r6 with owner in r5. A union built from a zero alignment bit and a 31-bit halfword address does it: combine folds the two field stores into the ldr after cse2, and its masks (1, 0x7FFFFFFF-ish) do not collide with the velocity stores' 0xFFFF/0xFFFF0000 as the u16 halves did. The 1/31 split is also what puts kind in sb over the 0x3FF mask (the other splits tie at 5 refs).

name: SceneActorBehavior_AccelerateTowardDescriptor
note: Concession-free (was a pin). The table value is multiplied by speed at the call (ScaleProduct(table[i] * speed)), so the ldrsh result is its own local temp: block 16 then has three local qtys, and block_alloc's hand sort (scope README fact 38) allocates the first-born table pointer first, giving it r0 as in the ROM.

name: SceneActorReaction_PlayStaggerBurst
note: Concession-free (was pins). Three changes: the 3 for the state store is a variable set before the bitfield store and reset after it, so cse stores it (r1) while the random mask takes the 3 the folded bitfield store made (r4); the mask is applied as mode = x & 3; mode++; and the random value is read as *(u16 *)(RANDOM_TABLE_ADDR + (gRandomIndex << 1)), which fixes the table-load order and the later reload rotation.

name: SceneActorControl_ConsumeLiftFlag
note: Concession-free (std-1 holdout; was pins and an asm barrier). The two flag updates are full-width bitfield stores (LiftParameters.flags : 8 at +0xF, LiftHalfBits.bits : 16 on flags2D4): each store's and-mask is the zero the ROM sets between the load and the orr, which gives the separate r4/r3 zeros. The OR constants come first (u8 bit = 8; u32 bit = 0x100) and the behavior 3 is a u8 local set before the state stores.

name: LinkSelection_UpdateParticipantScores

name: sub_081BB904
